features.description: default_bus_layout.tres (Master limiter; Voice; Ship with Voice-sidechained compressor and reverb, Ambience/Effects/Instruments under it; UI; empty Music); audio/sound_director.gd (cue table loader/validator, deterministic variant and pitch from (cue id, fire count), cue log ring buffer, 2D/3D players, listener rule); data/audio/cues.json + assets.json (schemas stapledons.audio.cues/1, stapledons.audio.assets/1); per-bus volume settings, Mute when unfocused, Reduced audio in ui/game_settings.gd; the conversation and ArchiveVoice players onto the Voice bus. Cue clocks: sim tick + event index, impact ship time, input sequence, integer millimetres; never frames or wall time.

features.notes: Built: audio/sound_mix.gd (bus layout from one table, volume taper (p/100)^2, Reduced audio, Mute when unfocused), audio/sound_data.gd (cue and manifest validators; source_kind + provenance + allow_generated=false, D-101), audio/sound_director.gd (sim events, state edges, UI signals, game states, integer-mm walk; clocks never frames; deterministic variation; cue log), GameSettings [audio], main.gd applies settings, voices on the Voice bus, export filter, mk/sound.mk. make sound-test 31 passed (incl. negative controls), cue log byte-identical in two processes; title-screen-test 102 passed with the audio settings. Tests were written alongside the code, not strictly red first. Deviations: Master default 100% (not 80%); bus volume taper (p/100)^2 instead of linear dB; no default_bus_layout.tres (the layout is built in code from SoundMix.BUSES and checked against it).

ailang verify tools/audio/synth.ail proves clamp16's range contract

make sound-check: per-cue bands and peaks <= -3 dBFS; the capture before the Master limiter peaks <= -1 dBFS with every cue at once and the limiter is present; voice ducks Ship >= 6 dB; hum and boost keep >= -6 dB through a 150 Hz high-pass; the +6 dB hot fixture fails (AC6)
make sound-review STAGE=s0 publishes each cue and a 30 s hum-and-room loop to gs://stapledons-voyage-assets/refs/sound/s0/ with per-file URLs
features.notes: Built: tools/audio (AILANG package stapledons/audio): synth.ail (pure, strict VM: sines with exponential glides, filtered periodic noise, envelopes, swell, normalise, int16 with a verified clamp16 contract and inline tests), synth_main.ail (FS shell: WAVs + data/audio/assets_synth.json), synth_test.ail, review_main.ail (Ogg Opus via std/audio + WAV fallback, mixes). data/audio/recipes.json (17 recipes), cues.json (17 cues with bands, name, when, listen_for), assets.json. tools/sound_check.gd (offline levels against bands, 150 Hz high-pass survival, mixer routing, ducking 11.3 dB, all-at-once pre-limiter peak -3.8 dBFS, hot negative control), tools/sound_assets_check.gd, tools/sound_review.gd. make sound-synth-check: check + verify + strict VM = interpreter (synth-ok 28ee28...) + 17 sounds regenerate byte for byte; sound-check 25 passed; sound-assets-check 17 files, 4.8 MB. As built: assets/audio is .gdignore'd per repo convention (no Godot import, no QOA); make sound-stage bundles the WAVs as audio_bundle/*.bin for export. Opus files decode (macOS afconvert) to the WAV levels within 0.02 dB.
